A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the efficiency of the generation of stimulated Raman radiation increases with increase in the gradient of the refractive-index profile.
the stimulated Raman scattering can be efficiently excited by a Gaussian pump light beam in a graded-index fiber waveguide with a parabolic refractive index distribution.
the efficiency of the stimulated Raman scattering can be increased by increasing the pump power, decreasing the fiber length, and increasing the index difference and the refractive index of the core.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the efficiency of SRS is independent of the pump beam focusing at the fiber entrance.
the refractive index of a fiber waveguides can be used to control the process of parametric coupling of interacting waves.
the efficiency of the stimulated Raman scattering process in a graded-index fiber waveguide is independent of the beam focusing of a pump Gaussian beam.
